python3 -c "
# Compute all values precisely
revenue_actual = 35082.0
guidance_mid = 32500.0
guidance_pct = 0.02
guidance_upper = guidance_mid * (1 + guidance_pct)
revenue_gap = revenue_actual - guidance_upper

print(f'Guidance upper end: {guidance_upper}')
print(f'Revenue actual: {revenue_actual}')
print(f'Revenue gap: {revenue_gap}')

# Non-GAAP gross profit
gaap_gp = 26156.0
adj_a = 116.0
adj_b = 50.0
adj_c = 0.0
ngaap_gp = gaap_gp + adj_a + adj_b + adj_c
print(f'Non-GAAP gross profit: {ngaap_gp}')

# Adjusted gross margin
ngaap_margin = (ngaap_gp / revenue_actual) * 100
print(f'Non-GAAP gross margin: {ngaap_margin}')

# Margin gap (rebuilt margin minus prior non-GAAP guidance upper end)
# Guidance: midpoint 75.0%, range_width 50 basis points
# Upper end = 75.0 + 0.50 = 75.50%
guidance_nngaap_mid = 75.0
guidance_nngaap_bps = 50.0
guidance_nngaap_upper = guidance_nngaap_mid + (guidance_nngaap_bps / 100.0)
margin_gap_bps = (ngaap_margin - guidance_nngaap_upper) * 100
print(f'Non-GAAP guidance upper end: {guidance_nngaap_upper}')
print(f'Margin gap (bps): {margin_gap_bps}')

# Conclusion check
print(f'Exceeded upper end? {ngaap_margin > guidance_nngaap_upper}')
"
